title: Fire Emblem: Shadow Dragon and the Blade of Light
shortDescription: Fire Emblem: Shadow Dragon and the Blade of Light helps define a Nintendo Entertainment System strategy path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Frames a strategy catalog entry for source-aware Nintendo Entertainment System exploration.
Keeps the external item link distinct from the deterministic catalog method.
keywords: Fire Emblem: Shadow Dragon and the Blade of Light

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Cataloged for the Nintendo Entertainment System strategy discovery path using the documented Wikidata platform mapping; this remains a catalog-method note with no imported numerical signal.
